verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a developer platform with published docs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence only lists a 'Checkout API reference' in llms.txt and markdown docs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
